description: This file defines a static class 'TestExtensions' providing extension methods 'WithTimeout' for Task and Task<T>, enabling timeout functionality for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: TestExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Tasks to implement timeout functionality.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: An extension method that applies a timeout to a Task, throwing TimeoutException if the task does not complete within the specified timespan.

parameters.name: taskToComplete
parameters.description: The task to execute with a timeout.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The maximum duration to wait for the task.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: An extension method that applies a timeout to a Task<T>, returning the task's result if completed in time, or throwing TimeoutException otherwise.

parameters.name: taskToComplete
parameters.description: The task to execute with a timeout.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The maximum duration to wait for the task.
